item.content:encoded:
I am a dedicated Data Scientist and Political Scientist with a robust academic and professional background. Currently, I am pursuing a Ph.D. in Political Science at the Institute of Social and Political Studies (IESP) at the State University of Rio de Janeiro (UERJ). My research focuses on Electoral Authoritarianism, guided by Professor Fernando Henrique Eduardo Guarnieri. I hold a Master’s degree in Political Science from the same institution, where I explored the impacts of electoral reforms in contemporary Russia.

Academic Background

    • IESP-UERJ, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Mar 2020 - Dec 2024)

  • Master’s in Political Science

    • IESP-UERJ, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Mar 2018 - Dec 2019)

  • Bachelor’s in Political Science

Programming Languages & Technologies:

With a solid foundation in both academic and practical realms, I bring a unique perspective to the intersection of data science and political science. My work aims to leverage advanced data techniques to uncover insights and drive informed decision-making in various fields. Whether in the classroom or the research lab, my passion lies in unraveling complex data to tell compelling stories and inform policy.
